- Ann < Dev, and Ben = Ann+1 with Ben ≠ Ivo or Dev, so Ben and Ann both sit before the block. Ann must also be at least 3 from Ivo, so Ann ≤ i−3.
- Finn = Ben+1 and Hana = Ann−1, so Hana, Ann, Ben, Finn form a run of four, all before the block.
- Cara < Hana, so Cara is also before the block. That puts five people before the block, so i−1 ≥ 5, which forces i = 6.
- Slots 2–5 hold the run Hana, Ann, Ben, Finn, and Cara must come before Hana, so Cara = 1 and Hana = 2.

**Check against all 15 constraints:** Gus = Dev+1 (8=7+1), Ann = Hana+1 (3=2+1), Dev before Gus (7<8), |Ben−Cara| = 3, Ben before Gus (4<8), Dev = Ivo+1 (7=6+1), |Ben−Elif| = 5, Finn = Ben+1 (5=4+1), |Gus−Ivo| = 2 (one person between), Elif = Gus+1 (9=8+1), |Finn−Hana| = 3, Ann before Dev (3<7), |Ann−Ivo| = 3, Cara before Hana (1<2), Ben = Ann+1 (4=3+1). All hold.
